postload_actions.text:
I was never a man of many vices. 
 
 
 (Space Bar or Click to Continue)

I punched in at work on time. 
 Never caused any trouble.

My manager, Tanaka-san, described my output as 'Above Below Exceeds Expectations'. 
 But I did have a weakness.

When I wasn't at the office, I spent every moment at the Pachinko Parlor... 
 Looking for my lucky break.

Unfortunately, I also spent all my money there. 
 But I had a plan to get it back.

I'd heard tell of a legendary Pachinko machine, discovered in the ruins of Ancient Babylon. 
 They said that one round at this table could restore a man's fortunes... or destroy them.

I found this machine. 
 I placed my last Yen in its crumbling slot. 
 I turned the knob and watched those balls, tumbling through the pins.
